properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 5:01PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 501 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a shower 6 miles south of
Commerce City, or 5 miles northeast of Denver, moving southeast at 10
mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Northeastern Denver and western Aurora.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 4:48PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 447 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Holly, or 8 miles northwest of Coolidge, moving south at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and brief heavy rain. There is also
the potential for brief gustnadoes.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Holly, Granada, and Hartman.
